_comment: The image-forge remote backend's model inventory. install_forge.ps1 downloads
the 'hf' rows from Hugging Face; the 'copy' rows come from halo.local over SFTP
(paths under 'from' are on the Halo box) - they are already paid for, no re-download.
Dest folders are relative to the ComfyUI root (C:\forge\ComfyUI by default);
a 'dest' field downloads the file from the repo path in 'file' and moves it to 'dest'.
Qwen-Image-2.1 repos are qwen-research licensed: sign in, accept the license on each
repo page, and run 'hf auth login' in the venv before downloading, or hf exits 401/403.

hf.why: Qwen-Image-2.1 unified gen+edit+native-RGBA, int8 (Unsloth: int8 > fp8 by LPIPS; Turing has int8 tensor cores)
2.1's dedicated VAE (16x spatial: legal sizes are 32-multiples)

hf_optional_gguf.why: RAM tier for the 11 GiB card (needs ComfyUI-GGUF, installed); repo-root file, lands in models/gguf/ where the loader looks

copy_from_halo.why: zero-download bring-up pipeline (works before any HF download)
